name: B10-0226/2026 (S&D) – Shortcomings and deficiencies of the ‘Amnesty Law’ in Venezuela
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on shortcomings and deficiencies of the ‘Amnesty Law’ in Venezuela
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for all remaining political prisoners in Venezuela to be freed and for a full, transparent application of the country's Amnesty Law, which it says has not been properly carried out or independently monitored. It condemns the United States military intervention and the abduction of Nicolás Maduro. It asks the European Union and its member states to keep sending humanitarian aid and to use diplomatic, legal and financial tools to support democratic reforms, including reform of the courts and electoral bodies.

- The Parliament asks for the release of all remaining political prisoners and independent monitoring of the Amnesty Law.
- It affects Venezuela's government, prisoners and people in need of aid.
- Next, the EU and member states are urged to keep aid flowing and push for democratic reforms.
